newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh refinery to set up new unit.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh refinery to set up new unit.

text.p: Eastern Refinery Limited (ERL), Bangladesh's only oil refinery in Chittagong, will soon set up a three-million-tonne annual capacity unit, ERL officials said on Monday.

They said a five-member team of experts from Malaysia's Petronas, which signed an agreement with Bangladesh on this last year, would soon visit the site beside the existing ERL plant run by state-owned Bangladesh Petroleum Corporation.

To be built on five acres of land, the plant would produce 365,000 tonnes of refined petrol and octane, 475,000 tonnes of kerosene, 840,000 tonnes of diesel, 980,000 tonnes of furnace oil, 30,000 tonnes of liquified petroleum gas and other products.
The products would be distributed through state-managed oil companies Padma, Jamuna and Meghna.
The new unit was expected to go into production by December 1998, ERL officials said.
Presently, the refinery has a capacity to refine 1.2 million tonnes of crude annually.
